I told Hollis in his #central-team thread that Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in the same channel on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel has changed it since.

I couldn't check the number against anything else. I found no Marrow Agrisupply files in the share, so Tobias's post is my only source.
